judged_text: feed_key is defined (with a comment-implied purpose of conditional fetching via If-Modified-Since) but is never read anywhere in the diff, so every hourly run re-downloads and re-parses the full feed. Dead code that misleads the next maintainer into believing modified-time throttling exists; the actual behavior is a full unthrottled fetch every hour against the source site.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `feed_key` is defined and memoizes a Redis key (`"feed-modified:..."`) but it is never referenced anywhere else in the diff. The actual polling implementation always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` with no conditional/modified-time check, so the method is dead code and its naming/commentary could mislead maintainers into thinking some modified-time throttling exists when it does not.
